title: The Composition of the Qur'an: Rhetorical Analysis
author: Michel Cuypers
edition: London: Bloomsbury Academic, 2015 (tr. Jerry Ryan); French orig. La composition du Coran, Pendé: Gabalda, 2012. Most relevant for the target sūras: Une apocalypse coranique: une lecture des trente-trois dernières sourates du Coran (Gabalda, 2014) / A Qurʾānic Apocalypse: A Reading of the Thirty-Three Last Sūrahs of the Qurʾān (Atlanta: Lockwood Press, 2018) — sūras 82–114.
coverage: rhetorical structure (parallelism, concentric composition) of sūras; the 2014/2018 book covers 82–114

target_coverage.81-114: per-sūra rhetorical structure in the AnIsl/MIDEO articles below and in A Qurʾānic Apocalypse
